defaultPrompt: Help me turn this CAD idea into a clear design specification.

interface.longDescription: Develop a CAD design, improve a design specification, or review a spec with independent AI reviewers. Reviewers start without the earlier conversation to help spot missing context, unclear requirements, and hidden assumptions — checked against the live CAD model. Manufacturing, cost, sustainability, and PLM reviewers each check their own lens. You decide which changes to make. Reviews require a local executor and isolated subagents. Cloud support remains partial.
